description: This file implements Windows-specific disk cache file operations, including asynchronous IO handling, file initialization, reading, writing, and length management within the Chromium project.

classes.name: CompletionHandler
classes.description: Handles IO completion notifications for asynchronous file operations in the disk cache.

classes.name: MyOverlapped
classes.description: Represents overlapped IO operation data, including file reference, callback, and IO context.

methods.name: File::Init
methods.description: Initializes the file object with a Windows file handle, setting up IO handler registration.

methods.name: File::Read
methods.description: Performs synchronous read from the file at a specified offset.

methods.name: File::Write
methods.description: Performs synchronous write to the file at a specified offset.

methods.name: File::Read (overload)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous read with callback support.

methods.name: File::Write (overload)
methods.description: Performs asynchronous write with callback support.

methods.name: File::SetLength
methods.description: Sets the length of the file.

methods.name: File::GetLength
methods.description: Retrieves the current length of the file.

methods.name: File::AsyncWrite
methods.description: Helper for performing asynchronous write operations.
